# Bundled OCR assets

Generated by `node scripts/vendor-ocr.mjs` after `npm ci`.

- Tesseract.js 7.0.0: https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js (Apache-2.0; see TESSERACT-LICENSE).
- Tesseract.js-core 7.0.0: https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core (Apache-2.0; see CORE-LICENSE).
- English recognition data from @tesseract.js-data/eng 1.0.0, best_int build: https://github.com/naptha/tessdata (package metadata says MIT; the traineddata repository provides the Apache-2.0 license at https://github.com/naptha/tessdata/blob/gh-pages/LICENSE, whose text is also included in TESSERACT-LICENSE). No package JavaScript from the data package is bundled.
- Bundled dependency notices are preserved in bundle.LICENSE.txt and worker.LICENSE.txt.

The application sets workerPath, corePath and langPath to these local assets, with workerBlobURL disabled. No screen images are uploaded. These are third-party library assets, not captured images or browser/session data.
